{{Quote|Ah. Exquisite. I will be requiring more rakghouls for my work, Vorzoth.''"<br />"''We already gave you the rakghouls you asked for. When will you do as we asked?|Dorant and Vorzoth|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Vorzoth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[nekghoul]] who entered into an agreement with [[Ryler Dorant]], a [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], where Vorzoth would provide Dorant with [[rakghoul]]s for his research in exchange for help attacking the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. However, Vorzoth and Dorant were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by [[Havoc Squad]] before Dorant could complete his research.
